title: Config.Settled
description: The payload of config's settling event (topic troupe.core.config.aggregate:Config.Settled), which ends a fork in the config stream: its parents are every head, and its state is the config the merge worked out from them. It's recorded with the first change after a merge, in the same batch. Field names are as recorded.

topic.description: The aggregate whose stream the event settles: config's.

state.description: The settled state: the config the merge worked out from every head.

config.description: The merged config, as groups of values.
